subject: Quantara trial KPIs & proposed POC timeline
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha@quantara.ai>, Ben Lewis <ben.lewis@quantara.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2025 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Quantara trial KPIs & proposed POC timeline

Hi Aisha / Ben,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good first conversation. Below is a concise recap from our discovery + a proposed POC plan so we can align on success criteria, timing, and owners. Please flag anything you want us to change.

Call recap (2 mins):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Quantara’s customer-facing summarization microservice and measure economics/perf under production-like load.
- Primary concerns you raised: 95p latency, predictable throughput, token cost, and output quality for legal/finance doc summaries.

Proposed POC success criteria (we recommend making 3 gate checks: baseline, mid-run, final):
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 300 ms for 512-token prompts (measured from request arrival to first token emitted).
2) Throughput: sustained 50 requests/sec with 99% availability over a 1-hour soak.
3) Cost: average effective cost <= $0.0009 per input token (end-to-end metering including caching benefit).
4) Quality: human eval pass-rate >= 92% on a 200-sample blind set (QA rubric we’ll provide), and no >1% regression in ROUGE-L vs current baseline.
5) Safety/PII: no sensitive PII leakage in outputs on our 100-sample probe tests.

Roles & ownership:
- Quantara: provide ground-truth test set + example traffic pattern (owner: Aisha Malik).
- Redwood SE: Priyom Das — test harness, baseline runs, instrumentation.
- Redwood CS/SRE: Grace O'Connor — provisioning of a dedicated trial instance and observability dashboard.
- Exec sponsor: Ben Lewis.

High-level timeline (proposed):
- May 5: Kickoff + SOW signature (admin + credentials)
- May 6-9: Baseline collection & small smoke tests (sanity)
- May 12-30: Full trial run (load windows scheduled; see attached calendar template)
- May 31 - Jun 4: Evaluation and results review; decision meeting week of Jun 8

Deliverables / Data we’ll share:
- Redwood POC template + KPI sheet (attached)
- Drive folder with test harness and run logs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-PoC-harness
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Immediate next steps:
1) If that timeline looks good, I’ll send a short SOW (one-pager) and calendar invites for kickoff and instrumentation walkthrough.
2) Aisha: share the 200-sample evaluation set and a simple traffic profile (qps, avg tokens) prior to May 6.
3) Priyom/Grace: confirm availability for May 5–9 baseline window.

Attachments: redwood_poc_template_v3.pdf (POC checklist), quantara_poc_kpi_sheet.xlsx (KPI tracker).

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Aisha Malik <aisha@quantara.ai>

Subject: Re: Quantara trial KPIs & proposed POC timeline

Thanks, Sergio — this is very helpful and clear. Quick notes from our side: 

- The targets look reasonable overall. One point — given our customer SLA, can we relax the latency gate to 95p <= 350 ms instead of 300 ms? We want to build headroom for long-context docs.
- We will provide the 200-sample evaluation set by EOD May 2.
- For cost, can you confirm whether your cost/token figure is before or after any cache/batching savings? We need the effective end-to-end number.
- Also, our security team requires a short note on data retention for the trial (how long logs are kept, who can access).

I’ll loop in our Security contact if needed. Ben — are you OK with the timeline as proposed?

Aisha Malik
Head of ML Product | Quantara
aisha@quantara.ai

Aisha — quick technical clarifications and what we’ll deliver from the SE side:

- Cost/token: the $0.0009 is our estimated effective cost after typical batching and prefix KV cache benefits; during the trial we’ll report both raw per-token compute and the observed end-to-end cost so you can see savings.
- Latency measurement: we’ll instrument for server-side generation latency and client-perceived time-to-first-byte; we’ll provide a short script to reproduce the metric.
- Throughput soak: we recommend three 1-hour soak windows (low/med/high) to ensure stability.
- Eval harness: we’ll run a 200-sample blind check (your set) + an automated 1k-sample throughput pass. Please provide ground truth + expected failure modes.
- Logs & retention: for the trial we retain logs for 30 days. Access is limited to assigned SRE/SE. If Quantara requires extended retention or different access controls, we’ll add that to the SOW.

I’ll upload the test harness and a sample run log to the Drive folder by EOD. Also attaching a minimal run script that writes CSV outputs that map to the KPI sheet.

— Priyom
